svg.title: A day at the lake, with Mimi the cat watching
svg.desc: An animated pixel-art landscape that runs through one full day on a slow loop, opening at golden hour. Light rays fan out from a low copper sun, the hills and lake turn warm, the sun sets, fireflies drift over the grass at dusk, a shooting star crosses the night under a rising moon, and morning brings a clear blue sky. Clouds drift, the lake shimmers with the mirrored sky and hills, grass sways, and smoke curls from a small cabin whose window glows after dark. Mimi, a small dark cat, sits on the near hill, swishing her tail, flicking an ear, blinking slowly and turning her head toward the sunset, the moon, or you.
